reviews.title: Quality is iffy from my experience
reviews.comment: I bought 2 sticks back in October of 2025. They both worked great until about a month ago, one of them stopped working. I didn’t adjust any settings in my BIOS to make them run faster than their rated clock speed. With how expensive RAM is currently, these should not be failing in 6 months. Now I’m stuck with an expensive paperweight cus BestBuy won’t let me replace it or return it
